profile.headline: Full Stack Software Developer at ORNL

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
·	Developed responsive user interfaces using React and Redux, ensuring seamless front-end experiences
·	Implemented RESTful APIs using C# and .NET, facilitating efficient communication between front-end and back-end systems for data retrieval and manipulation.
·	Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions, ensuring alignment with project objectives and timelines.
·	Utilized C# and .NET frameworks to build scalable and maintainable back-end services, leveraging object-oriented principles for code efficiency and readability.
·	Integrated third-party APIs and libraries to expand application functionalities, enhancing user experiences and introducing new features in line with project requirements.
·	Participated in code reviews and provided constructive feedback to team members, fostering a collaborative and continuous improvement-oriented development environment.
·	Documented technical specifications, architectural designs, and development processes, contributing to comprehensive project documentation for future reference and team knowledge sharing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Mitigated system security vulnerabilities identified by a static analyzer including the development of a class to handle environment variables used by the system. (C++)
· Communicated with a variety of hardware devices each controlled by a state-machine process loop using a client-server architecture to handle intra-communication. (C++)
· Worked with customer to diagnose data validation and processing issues due to problems with automated email signing that uses a smart-card system. (C++, Red Hat, OpenSSL)
· Contributed to software documentation for test procedures, software design description, programmer’s manual, etc. and custom UML generation. (Tcl)
· Update project repository to allow for branching and merging in addition to writing Bash scripts to assist with Subversion commands and to improve the efficiency of development. (Bash, svn)
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Security · Operating Systems · Hardware

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
· Researched, designed, and prototyped a geolocation mapping web app using the Angular framework and TypeScript with data stored in an SQL database
· Replaced deprecated database library with internal database SDK
· Maintained and updated automated and manual test suites

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
· Implemented a new test-framework feature to save and load large network-flow graphs using bulk function calls to increase the efficiency of tests and reduce the time taken to write new tests using C# and ASP.NET Core 
· Developed a multithreaded Windows application to asynchronously install and configure multiple products onto different remote machines (C#/ASP.NET Framework)	
· Supervised a team of interns developing small internal projects
· Created and expanded upon UI tests for data collection website using the Selenium framework (C#)
